title: Redundant Clones on Copy Types
pattern: Calling `.clone()` on a type that implements the `Copy` trait.
why_bad: Implicitly suggests that a heavy heap allocation or deep copy is taking place, confusing the reader regarding the type's performance characteristics.
detection: Calling `.clone()` on variables whose static type implements `Copy` (e.g., primitives, simple inline aggregates).
fix: Remove the `.clone()` call, relying on standard implicit copy mechanics.
